questionText: The figure in Panel I below is a grid of cells with four rows and four columns. The numbers on the top and on the left represent the number of cells that are to be shaded in that column and row, respectively. Which one of the options shown in Panel II below represents the grid shaded correctly?
explanation:
Step 1: Identify the constraints from Panel I.
• Row counts (top to bottom): Row 1 requires $3$ shaded cells, Row 2 requires $1$, Row 3 requires $2$, and Row 4 requires $2$.
• Column counts (left to right): Columns 1, 2, 3, and 4 each require exactly $2$ shaded cells.

Step 2: Evaluate grid (ii).
• Row 1: $3$ shaded cells (columns 1, 3, 4)
• Row 2: $1$ shaded cell (column 2)
• Row 3: $2$ shaded cells (columns 3, 4)
• Row 4: $2$ shaded cells (columns 1, 2)

Checking column sums for grid (ii):
• Column 1: $2$ shaded cells (rows 1, 4)
• Column 2: $2$ shaded cells (rows 2, 4)
• Column 3: $2$ shaded cells (rows 1, 3)
• Column 4: $2$ shaded cells (rows 1, 3)

Since grid (ii) satisfies all row and column constraints, option (B) is the correct choice.
